notes: Anti-accumulation chunking (user spec 2026-11-02): a 500ms pause (0.5s, not 5s) dispatches the chunk immediately; fluent speech past a 400-char cap dispatches at a sentence/clause boundary instead of accumulating; a long final is split into sequential capped pieces, each through the normal gate/cache/provider path, so no provider ever receives one giant request (MyMemory 500-char limit). Pause timer arms only on text change and survives session restarts. v1.22 echo rule, v1.21 routing/atomicity and v1.19 caches unchanged. No new permission, no new STT engine, no internal-audio capture, no voice commands, no model download. Google 429 / backend NO_MATCH residual failure is not claimed fixed; the phone verdict comes from normal use.
